request.text: Wait. Let me look at you. Hold still. Something looks out of you. Suit yourself. But nobody goes down there without our leave. Hold the light up when you're under. It knows the way better than you do. Don't look at me like that. I saw what I saw.
request.voice_description: Native English, British, a broad rural accent of the East Anglian fens. Female, 20-25. Excellent quality. Persona: the youngest of three swamp witches, a seer who sees more than she wants to. Emotion: watchful, uneasy, blunt, a little defiant, quietly frightened. A low, soft, slightly husky voice, slow and intent, as if looking through the person she talks to.
